text: Every time I try to export my project to PDF, the app crashes. I have lost two hours of work. This is completely unacceptable for a paid product.
It would be really useful to have a bulk-assign feature on the team settings page. Right now I have to add people to each project one by one, which takes forever when onboarding new employees.
Hi, I am not sure how to connect my Google Calendar integration. The docs mention a settings panel but I cannot find it anywhere in the new UI.
Best project management app I have ever used. The keyboard shortcuts are incredibly well thought out and have genuinely changed how my team works. Five stars.
The search results are taking 8 to 10 seconds to load on workspaces with more than 500 tasks. Other actions on the same workspace are fast, so it seems isolated to search.
Please add a dark mode. I work late at night and the white interface is very harsh on my eyes. Many of your competitors already have this.
Our entire team cannot log in. We are all getting a 503 error. We have a product launch in three hours and this is a serious problem.
The date picker in the task creation modal does not respect the locale setting I configured. It always shows MM/DD/YYYY even though I have set the locale to UK English (DD/MM/YYYY).
Would love to see an API endpoint for webhooks so we can push task status changes into our internal Slack channels without needing a third-party integration tool.
The onboarding flow is super smooth. I got my whole team set up in under 20 minutes. The checklist approach really helped us not miss anything important.
